desc: Ideation: parity invariant (R even necessary), all-blue bipartite constraint (B even when R=0); No iff R odd or (R=0 and B odd)
Base cases verified by hand: R=2/B=0, B=2/R=0, R=2B=1, R=4B=2, R=2B=3 (sample)
Implement mixed-case construction: B≥R staircase+rectangle; B<R via a=1 + blue L-path + red run2 greedy diagonal path; special-case R=2
Write self-check harness (counts, distinctness, per-type adjacency incl. wrap, bounds) and fix (s0,d0) offsets so r,c≥1 always
Run SELFTEST and confirm all validations pass; fix any diag_path collisions (reroute red run2 left-first below the blue leg, climb at s=s0−2) if failures appear
Finalize full solver, sanity-check sample cases by hand, output final code
